### Why DO NOT SHIP
Defects #1 and #2 are silent data/pricing-correctness bugs in the two most business-critical flows (registration and checkout) — they don't crash, so they're the kind of bug that reaches production undetected and causes real customer/financial harm. Combined with a dead "Export" action and missing form validation, this build needs fixes and a re-test pass before it should ship.'
